title: Guard the UE import and paid contact-sheet routes as chaos-cloth is
body:
## Summary
POST /api/visual-gen/ue-import launches the UE editor and POST /api/visual-gen/contact-sheet spends a paid generation, and neither calls requireOperator, while chaos-cloth does.

## Description
chaos-cloth names requireOperator as the rule for UE-spawning control-plane routes. The two routes this context serves have no guard. The routes are outside this context's declared paths, so this round did not edit them; the python-injection half was closed inside importGlbToUE. Anchors: src/app/api/visual-gen/chaos-cloth/route.ts:53, src/app/api/visual-gen/ue-import/route.ts:35, src/app/api/visual-gen/contact-sheet/route.ts:88.

## Flow
- Add requireOperator to both POST handlers
- Run every test importing either route, per the brief's route-guard rule, and fix hand-built stub requests

## Expected impact
Only an operator can start an editor or spend credits through these routes. Could break callers that do not send the operator header.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - unguarded spend and process-launch routes
Before: 1 of 3 sampled routes guarded
After: 3 of 3 (predicted)
Method: simulation - route files are out of this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
instrument: a route test asserting 401/403 without the operator header on both POSTs, plus every existing suite importing those routes

title: Contact sheet seam contrast never measures horizontal cuts
body:
## Summary
The sheet gate reports seam contrast from vertical cuts only, so drawn horizontal grid lines or subjects straddling a row cut are not seen.

## Description
seamXs holds only column boundaries of row 0, and sharpImageOps.stats computes only colGrad. A sheet with visible row lines reads as clean in seamNote. Fixed means SheetImageOps also takes seamYs and gradeSheet folds both axes into the ratio. Anchors: src/lib/visual-gen/sheet-slice.ts:127.

## Flow
- Add seamYs to SheetImageOps.stats and a rowGrad in the route ops
- Feed both into seamContrasts
- Test with a synthetic image holding row lines only

## Expected impact
The advisory seam number covers both axes. It changes a reported ratio; the reference 0.85 was measured on vertical cuts only and would need re-measuring.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the seam reading covers every cut
Before: 0 of 3 horizontal cuts measured on a 4x4 sheet
After: 3 of 3 (predicted)
Method: simulation - needs a real sharp fixture and a re-measured reference
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a sharp-generated PNG with drawn row lines only, ratio taken before and after

title: Linear prop ring frame flips when the tangent crosses the reference switch
body:
## Summary
Each ring picks its reference axis independently, so a steep sagging rope can twist abruptly at the ring where |tangent.y| crosses 0.9.

## Description
generateLinearProp recomputes right/up per ring from a reference chosen by threshold. Where the choice changes between adjacent rings the cross-section rotates and the quads between them shear. Parallel transport of one initial frame removes the discontinuity. Anchors: src/lib/visual-gen/generators/linear-prop.ts:170.

## Flow
- Measure the max ring-to-ring frame rotation over steep anchors with high slack
- Replace the per-ring reference with parallel transport
- Re-measure and confirm watertight and winding tests stay green

## Expected impact
Steep ropes stop pinching at one ring. Every ring position changes slightly, so any pinned mesh output moves.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no twist discontinuity along a tube
Before: not measured; the code path exists when tangent.y crosses 0.9
After: max ring rotation bounded by the curve bend (predicted)
Method: simulation - the twist metric does not exist yet
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: a test computing max ring-to-ring frame rotation for a steep high-slack span

title: UE import job map is never evicted
body:
## Summary
The module-global job Map grows for the life of the server and each job retains its full critique.

## Description
No job store under src/lib/visual-gen deletes entries (grep for jobs.delete, size, evict and TTL returned nothing), so this is a shared pattern and a single-store fix would leave the others. Anchors: src/lib/visual-gen/ue-import-job-store.ts:88.

## Flow
- Add a capped or TTL eviction of finished jobs
- Apply it across the job stores together
- Test that a running job is never evicted

## Expected impact
Bounded memory on long-lived dev servers. A client polling a very old id would get not-found.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - bounded job retention
Before: unbounded; 0 eviction sites
After: bounded (predicted)
Method: simulation - a heap figure needs a long-lived server
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a test starting more jobs than the cap and asserting finished ones are dropped and running ones kept

title: Diamond-square accepts a size that is not 2^n+1
body:
## Summary
The size contract is stated in a comment and enforced nowhere, so a bad size can leave rows unwritten at zero.

## Description
TerrainConfig.size says it must be a power of two plus one. generateDiamondSquare does not check. Walking size 130: step 129 then halves, so the last row is never visited and stays 0, which normalises into a false cliff. The function returns number[][] with no failure channel, so the fix needs a signature decision or a check in resolveTerrainBasis. Anchors: src/lib/visual-gen/generators/terrain.ts:170.

## Flow
- Confirm the unwritten row with a size-130 probe
- Add the check, likely in resolveTerrainBasis which already returns a Result
- Test 129 passes and 130 is refused

## Expected impact
A malformed size is refused instead of shipping a seam. Could reject configs persisted with an odd size.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - malformed terrain sizes refused
Before: accepted by reading; not executed
After: refused (predicted)
Method: simulation - walked by hand
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a size-130 probe counting rows left at exactly the minimum

title: heightmapToUint16 wraps values outside the 0-1 band
body:
## Summary
The export multiplies by 65535 and assigns to a Uint16Array, so a maxHeight above 1 or a negative minHeight wraps around.

## Description
minHeight and maxHeight are configurable, and a Uint16Array assignment wraps silently, turning high ground into low ground. The only callers are a test and a feature-definition mention, which is why this is low impact and not built. Anchors: src/lib/visual-gen/generators/terrain.ts:249.

## Flow
- Decide between clamping and normalising by the band
- Test a [0,2] field stays monotonic

## Expected impact
Correct export once a caller exists. No production caller today.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no wraparound in 16-bit export
Before: 0 production callers; wrap follows from Uint16Array semantics
After: monotonic export (predicted)
Method: simulation - no production path to measure
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a test exporting a [0,2] heightmap and asserting output order matches input order

title: Vegetation scatter throws on a zero radius or zero area
body:
## Summary
poissonDisk divides by radius and indexes grid[0] unconditionally, so radius 0 or a zero width or height throws instead of returning no points.

## Description
Radius 0 gives a cellSize of 0 and an infinite grid length, which throws a RangeError. Zero height gives an empty grid and grid[gj0] is undefined. Species are user-editable. The slider ranges in the Procedural Engine view were not checked, so reachability is unconfirmed. Anchors: src/lib/visual-gen/generators/vegetation.ts:72, src/lib/visual-gen/generators/vegetation.ts:87.

## Flow
- Check the view's slider minimums
- Return no points for a non-positive radius or area
- Test both

## Expected impact
A bad species config yields an empty species instead of a crashed generate.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - degenerate configs do not throw
Before: throw predicted by reading; not executed
After: empty result (predicted)
Method: simulation - walked by hand
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a test calling generateVegetation with radius 0 and with height 0

title: Dungeon returns no rooms silently when min room exceeds max
body:
## Summary
A minRoomSize above maxRoomSize makes every leaf bail, and the result is an empty dungeon with no stated reason.

## Description
placeRooms returns for every leaf and generateDungeon reports rooms: [] like a legitimate layout. DungeonResult has no reason field, so a fix needs one or a refusal at the view. The CellType door value is also never written by this generator, a related dead member. Anchors: src/lib/visual-gen/generators/dungeon.ts:101.

## Flow
- Check whether the view can produce min above max
- Surface a reason or clamp at the control

## Expected impact
The operator learns why a dungeon is empty.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - an empty result carries its reason
Before: rooms: [] with no reason
After: reason stated (predicted)
Method: simulation - walked by hand
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a test with minRoomSize 10 and maxRoomSize 5 asserting a stated reason

title: Kit coherence merges members that share a name
body:
## Summary
perMember is keyed by member name, so two members with one name pool their distances and the outlier can be misattributed.

## Description
gradeKitCoherence accumulates distance per name. Duplicate names are plausible for repeated kit parts. Keying by index and reporting the name removes the merge. Anchors: src/lib/visual-gen/kit-coherence.ts:187.

## Flow
- Key by index
- Test two same-named members with different palettes

## Expected impact
The named re-generate target is the right member. The grade is advisory, so the effect is small.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - outlier attribution
Before: merged by reading; not executed
After: per-member (predicted)
Method: simulation - walked by hand
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a test with duplicate member names asserting the outlier mean is not pooled

title: ScatterPoint scale comment disagrees with the generated range
body:
## Summary
The field comment says 0.5-1.5 and the code emits 0.7-1.3.

## Description
A reader sizing bounds from the type comment is off by 0.2 on both ends. Correct the comment or the range; the range is the behaviour existing layouts already have. Anchors: src/lib/visual-gen/generators/vegetation.ts:19, src/lib/visual-gen/generators/vegetation.ts:162.

## Flow
- Change the comment to 0.7-1.3
- Pin the range with a seeded test

## Expected impact
The contract is readable. No behaviour change.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - docs match code
Before: 1 stale range
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - a comment has no gate of its own
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a seeded test asserting every scale lies in 0.7-1.3
